item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02335","case1_error":"Treats car spending as savings toward the console, computing 600−340 instead of 600−(620−340).","case2_error":"Subtracts the $2 price increase from the bill instead of adding it.","reason":"Case 1 substitutes expenditure for available savings and omits earnings; case 2 reverses the sign of a correctly calculated surcharge.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02336","case1_error":"Invents an initial zero inventory and makes inconsistent updates instead of using the missing-half condition.","case2_error":"Ignores scheduled purchases and losses, then invents an increase to two balls after game eleven.","reason":"Case 1 fabricates the unknown starting inventory; case 2 starts correctly but fails to apply the recurring inventory changes.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02337","case1_error":"Gives unsupported 6186 after correctly stating the total-balloon and per-school formulas; the answer should be 859.","case2_error":"Treats two extra red pencils as two total red pencils in each special pack, omitting their original red pencils.","reason":"Case 1 has an unsupported final number after correct formulas; case 2 misinterprets an additional quantity as a total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02338","case1_error":"Incorrectly replaces O=0.25T with O=0.25(T−72), then claims O=2 from O=0.25O.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written expression 240−(80+120+10) as 50 instead of 30.","reason":"Case 1 introduces an erroneous relation and invalid equation solution; case 2 makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02339","case1_error":"Evaluates 22−7/3 incorrectly as 22⅔ and leaves the answer in yards despite the request for feet.","case2_error":"States correct total and percentage formulas but supplies unsupported 40.0; the correct percentage is 20%.","reason":"Case 1 explicitly miscalculates a subtraction and uses the wrong units. Case 2 provides an unexplained incorrect number after correct formulas.","judgment":"different"}]}
